GitHub Auto-Sync Not Configured Connect your GitHub repository so every app you add or edit automatically publishes to store-data.json for all visitors.
How to get a GitHub Token (1-minute setup)
  1. Open GitHub.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens.
  2. Click Generate new token, select your website repository under Repository access.
  3. Under Permissions → Repository permissions, set Contents to Read and write, then generate & paste it above.
  4. Your token is saved only on your own device (never uploaded to GitHub).
